<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Rupee recovery and RBI intervention:</strong> The Indian rupee strengthened significantly following new RBI administrative measures to curb dollar demand, though analysts warn that persistent yield gaps may necessitate further rate defense.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxQcndVWUFhem5vcDlYbTMxcktSaGNzalp6MkJBVFIzVTFmNlh3Z1M2Ym5tSVR0YUpGUDNHN25KdnBzdzZiUHQzemk3bE1JVTdmVHN3WFlKVXlCQ0RMZEU3bG1mZXUxNEJ3SEdTOVdNaklIX3dMVVdSWDg4QVFFREZTZjdUMDZiQUx1ZV9zcHJFY1NMVl95RlRwaUJucmQycUs1dEFLNTlHX29BUlZKMjd3TWxYU1g1ZTdJTURRM2xibjlvZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Bond yields and liquidity:</strong> India’s 10-year bond yield has climbed above 7.35% as the RBI’s liquidity tightening measures pressure the banking sector and weigh on Bank Nifty performance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market volatility and inflation:</strong> Despite a positive start, equity indices pared early gains as investors remain cautious over persistent FII selling and reports suggesting inflation could surge to 6-7%, potentially forcing further repo rate hikes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>
</ul>
